en.headline: Kai Tak Sports Park main stadium launches Asian Games light show from tonight
en.dek: A 30-minute dynamic display on the main stadium façade runs nightly from 8pm until 24 October, featuring cheer messages and visual motifs of Olympic sports including e-sports.
body: The main stadium at Kai Tak Sports Park begins a nightly Asian Games-themed light show this evening, running from 15 September to 24 October to coincide with the Games and the subsequent Asian Para Games.

Each performance lasts about 30 minutes and starts at 8pm. The display opens with bright colours intended to evoke sporting energy, then projects messages such as “全城上下撐港隊” and “GO! TEAM HKG”. Dynamic graphics of events including table tennis, cycling, fencing, football and the newly medalled e-sports discipline appear on the façade.

Organisers recommend viewing from Cheng Fung Road Park in Kai Tak, the Kai Tak Bridge in Kowloon Bay, or the Hoi Sham Park waterfront promenade in To Kwa Wan. The light show forms part of a wider package of support activities at the sports park, which also includes free live broadcasts of selected Games sessions in the retail atrium from 19 September and a limited-time Team HKG merchandise pop-up.

zh.headline: 啟德體育園主場館外牆今晚起上演亞運主題燈光展
zh.dek: 每晚8時至8時半，展至10月24日，展示「全城上下撐港隊」訊息及乒乓球、單車、劍擊、足球、電競等動感畫面。
body: 啟德體育園主場館外牆由今日（15日）起至10月24日每晚上演亞運主題大型動感燈光展，為名古屋亞運會及隨後的亞殘運造勢。
燈光展每晚8時開始，歷時約半小時。開場以繽紛色彩象徵運動活力，其後展示「全城上下撐港隊」及「GO! TEAM HKG」等打氣訊息，並以動感視覺效果呈現乒乓球、單車、劍擊、足球及今屆正式列為獎牌項目的電競等賽事畫面。
園方建議最佳觀賞地點為啟德承豐道公園、九龍灣啟德橋及土瓜灣海心公園海濱長廊。燈光展是體育園一系列應援活動的一部分，零售館中庭亦會由9月19日起免費直播精選賽事，並設有期間限定的港隊商品店。
